	<h1>How_it_went_for_me <a name='Nirrum's Encyclopedia of Varomar:Ctutoletl:Temple of the World Spirit:How it went for me'></a></h1>
	</div>

	<div class='content'>
	<p>
Created Wednesday 31 October 2018
</p>

<p>
The midgard party has been my testing ground for this.<br>
They have entered the Antechamber and hall of concept. At one point they <i>carved out the head of the world spirit mural. </i>Nothing happened but the tension at the table was high<br>
They've found the body and the tools and one player carved the World-spirit into part of the unfinished wall, modestly well. Again, nothing happened<br>
The real champion was when Vaylen, the warlock, used a spell to help read the poem on the door. One person tried to remove the gold but didn't think to make the arcana check first
</p>

<p>
Marilith -178 hexdex<br>
LAIR<br>
Ulferhd 15<br>
Zul13<br>
Vaylen 10<br>
Amethyst 10<br>
Sparkles 8
</p>

<h3>I intend to reward them with Magical tattoos and a level<a id="i-intend-to-reward-them-with-magical-tattoos-and-a-level" class="h_anchor"></a></h3>

<p>
Zul: Mark of the Tarrasque <a href="./How_it_went_for_me/Level.html" title="+level" class="page">+level</a> 10temp <a href="./How_it_went_for_me/Level.html" title="+Level" class="page">+Level</a> 1hp <a href="./How_it_went_for_me/Level.html" title="+level" class="page">+level</a> 15temp <a href="./How_it_went_for_me/Level.html" title="+level" class="page">+level</a> 10hp<br>
Vaylen: Mark of the spider <a href="./How_it_went_for_me/Level.html" title="+level" class="page">+level</a> No concentration, <a href="./How_it_went_for_me/Level.html" title="+level" class="page">+level</a> permanent <a href="./How_it_went_for_me/Level.html" title="+level" class="page">+level</a> fluid and unstable surfaces.<br>
Beatrix: Tattoo of striding  <a href="./How_it_went_for_me/Level.html" title="+level" class="page">+level</a> 3d ink (+level for Second leg, + Level for 3d second leg)<br>
Gaius: Spiritmaster <a href="./How_it_went_for_me/Level.html" title="+level" class="page">+level</a> corporeal <a href="./How_it_went_for_me/Level.html" title="+level" class="page">+level</a> no advantage <a href="./How_it_went_for_me/Level.html" title="+level" class="page">+level</a> any <a href="./How_it_went_for_me/Level.html" title="+level" class="page">+level</a> more than one<br>
Halselyne: Eye of Darkvision <a href="./How_it_went_for_me/Level.html" title="+level" class="page">+level</a> for permanent <a href="./How_it_went_for_me/Level.html" title="+level" class="page">+level</a> 10 extra<br>
Sparkles: Maw of the Dragon Acid <a href="./How_it_went_for_me/Level.html" title="+level" class="page">+level</a> Pick an extra element :|:|:|:|, Or regain on short or long rest, when all elements and shortening are picked, Damage is 6d6<br>
John: Mark of the snake charmer <a href="./How_it_went_for_me/Level.html" title="+level" class="page">+level</a> snakes are thrown up to 60ft <a href="./How_it_went_for_me/Level.html" title="+level" class="page">+level</a> for additional 1d6 snakes :|:|:|:|<br>
Amethyst: Artisan's hands Painter's. <a href="./How_it_went_for_me/Level.html" title="+level" class="page">+level</a> Expertise, <a href="./How_it_went_for_me/Level.html" title="+level" class="page">+level</a> moving ink, <a href="./How_it_went_for_me/Level.html" title="+level" class="page">+level</a> Nozlur's pigments long rest recharge, <a href="./How_it_went_for_me/Level.html" title="+level" class="page">+level</a> short rest <a href="./How_it_went_for_me/Level.html" title="+level" class="page">+level</a> permanent
</p>

<p>
Choice of ink
